children: Weyerhaeuser updated its Q3 2026 segment outlook and reiterated an accelerated growth plan targeting $1.5 billion of incremental Adjusted EBITDA by 2030.
Q3 2026 outlook: Timberlands slightly higher vs Q2; Strategic Land Solutions earnings ~$30M lower vs Q2; Wood Products EBITDA moderately (~$30M) lower vs Q2.
Maintains 2030 target to add $1.5B incremental Adjusted EBITDA measured against 2024 baseline across segments and enterprise initiatives.
Announces new Strategic Land Solutions segment (Real Estate, Natural Resources, Climate Solutions) with Climate Solutions growth and ~$340M 5-year avg Adj. EBITDA.
Advancing biocarbon strategy: JV for first biocarbon facility at McComb, MS and target to partner to deliver 1.5M tons of biocarbon by 2030.
Capital allocation: targets 75–80% of Adjusted FAD returned to shareholders; $400–450M average annual CapEx and ~$500M Monticello EWP investment (2025–27).
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Weyerhaeuser updates Q3 2026 outlook, targets $1.5B incremental Adjusted EBITDA by 2030
